Comment: Miner job ore veins - shared world resource nodes near world spawn. ModelId is the vein prop (Models.txt 612-616, the 'sanctuary'-themed mining nodes); ItemDefinitionId is the ore a successful gather grants (ClientItemDefinitions CategoryId 16); Name is the deposit, not the ore, and is only used in logs - the nameplate is hidden because there is no real localized 'X Vein' string to point at. Gather/respawn timing belongs to GatheringManager, not this file. These were hand-picked in game near where players actually land, and are a starter placement to be tuned against the live client - not the real Singing Crystal Mines, which isn't stood up yet.
Name: Copper Vein
